programme.desc: S01 E01 — Living Room Llamas Noel Collier takes on two different house hunts: one for a woman with 40 llamas and a kangaroo, and another for a couple seeking a Texas home with an underground bunker; from pets to prepping, Noel proves no request is too unusual.
programme.title: Extreme Buyers Club

programme.desc: S01 E03 — Victorian Vibes and Mermaid Dives Noel joins a macabre-loving couple who are searching for a Victorian home that can accommodate their growing collection of vintage oddities; scuba instructors and professional mermaid performers hunt for a property with acreage and a training pool.
programme.title: Extreme Buyers Club

programme.desc: S01 E06 — A Place to Land Noel takes on a 30-year-old deaf little person who's searching for an accessible first home, but his budget may stand in the way; a visionary looks for the perfect property to transform a retired Boeing 727 into a one-of-a-kind vacation rental.
programme.title: Extreme Buyers Club

programme.desc: S02 E01 — Stay for A-Wild Jack McBrayer hits the road to find unique homes in the U.S. and kicks things off at a home shaped like an actual shoe; he checks out an off-the-grid eco-house and stops by a hitmaker's hideaway.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S02 E02 — Where the Trolls Live Jack explores more unique and wild homes including a jam-packed mansion with a 25-seat movie theater, a replica mineshaft home situated on over 300 acres and a mountain home featuring a jungle theme and hidden rooms.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S02 E03 — The Good, the Bad, the Wild Jack is back on the hunt for the wildest homes, starting with a recently purchased homestead that puts the wild in Wild West; he also visits a quirky, whimsical house and a sailor's dream dwelling that are both for sale and ready for new owners.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S02 E04 — We Need to Steal a Chair Jack tours a French country-inspired mansion filled with ornate details and then a pink dream home bursting with playful decor; a Spanish hacienda purchased on a whim full of colorful tiles and enchanting gardens that took 21 years to complete.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S02 E06 — Halo Effect Jack's search for wild homes continues with more houses for sale: an artist's Technicolor high-rise and a serene angelic retreat; he visits a newly bought round home that has no flat walls or angles.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S02 E08 — Bottle-ottle-ottle Off to find more wild homes, Jack climbs up to a treetop oasis made from salvaged materials; then, he tours a property made out of glass bottles and visits a 19th century home that turned three structures into one unexpected residence.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S02 E09 — Triple Threat Jack's wild search takes him to a triple geodesic dome home created by the owner and a suburban house designed top to bottom with marble; he visits a newly-purchased Arizona ghost town to discover how the owners plan to bring it back to life.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S02 E10 — Let's Get It Tron Jack finds a Dallas home for sale inspired by sci-fi movies plus another in Taos, New Mexico, known as the Adobe Castle that doubles as an art museum; he also visits an earth home bought by a woman who drove 15 hours to make an offer on it.
programme.title: Zillow Gone Wild

programme.desc: S01 E04 — Lost in Space Leslie's disappointed after checking in at a Joshua Tree spaceship desert escape; broken furniture and a theme that's lost in space leave Jasmine with her hardest project yet.
programme.title: Roast My Rental

programme.desc: S01 E08 — Star-Quality Studio In Los Angeles, Leslie finds herself in a garage studio that's more crash pad than Hollywood glamor; with fake bamboo and old, bulky furnishings, this rental needs a head-to-toe redesign from Jasmine to make it an elegant rental fit for a celebrity.
programme.title: Roast My Rental

programme.desc: S01 E11 — Suites or Sheds!? What the shed?! In Topanga, California, wall-to-wall disappointment awaits Leslie and Jasmine as they contend with cramped spaces, poor design and an unfinished bathroom.
programme.title: Roast My Rental

programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S12 E05 — Second Chance Lottery After a close call with a motorcycle accident, a New York couple credits "My Lottery Dream Home" marathons as their motivation to get through rehabilitation; David is happy to help them find their own dream home in sunny St. Augustine, Fla.
programme.title: My Lottery Dream Home

programme.desc: S13 E11 — Texas Tranquility After an unexpected inheritance, a woman is finally able to buy a home near her daughter and grandchildren; She wants a house that's no more than ten minutes away from her family.
